about: Worked out with WoWSims Forever's own Stat Weights tool (wowsims.com/forever/mage/dps, game 1.60.1.70938). Its Frost Med preset (talents 18/0/33, rotation, buffs) on its own P1 Arcane gear set (the only mage set it has), 12,500 iterations, reference stat Spell Damage. DPS EP as the tool shows it; '1%' rows are per 1%. Run in John's Chrome on 14 Nov 2026 (US Central).
